name: pair_discount_arb
author: BlitzkriegBot
description: Pair-discount collector for binary rounds (@almach mechanism): when ask_UP + ask_DOWN + entry fees < max_pair_cost, buy BOTH legs at their asks with EQUAL declared share counts and collect by merging the complete pairs into $1.00/pair of collateral. Profit is locked at entry; the exit is a collection, not a decision — the kernel intercepts the strategy's merge intents before the sell ladder. v1.2 moves the entry to the maker side of the book (entry_maker: both legs rest post-only at their quoted asks and NEVER escalate to taker — at the current fee schedule a taker-filled pair pays ~3.5% round-trip against a ~2.5% discount, so the taker doctrine is dead; maker legs pay no taker fee) and confines NEW pair attempts to the round's FIRST half (entry_window 0.5 default — the @almach in-round evidence: fill density concentrates early, tail discounts are more expensive; maker_mode=0/entry_window=0 revert each). v1.1's GAP-FILL loop is unchanged: a partially-filled leg is topped up at its current ask (shortfall = counterpart holding − held, priced ask+fee vs $1 via max_top_up_cost). Fees priced from bk.fees(); no schedule in force means no entries. Signal-only: the kernel adjudicates, sizes, gates, merges and settles every intent.
